A '''planetoid''' was an irradiated world located within [[The Redoubt/Legends|The Redoubt]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="NEC" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], the ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' crash-landed on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]].<ref name="OB" />
